text:
Ivy: Heads-up  Keelan's bday next Thurs. Quick vote: mini glass terrarium (cute, low-maintenance) or bakery box (assorted pastries, local-only)?
Owen: Terrarium for remote folks, bakery box if everyone onsite. Hybrid wins?
Samir: Vote: terrarium. easier to ship + lasts longer.
Nora: Bakery box sounds yummy but fragile. If bakery, can we do local pickup + a small token mailed to remotes?
people-ops-bot: :ballot_box: Poll started  terrarium 2, bakery_box 1
Halle: Also budget note: terrariums ~$15 + $5 shipping; bakery boxes ~$25 but pickup avoids shipping for SF folks. We have $130 in fund.
Ivy: Allergy note: Keelan is allergic to sesame. No sesame items if bakery.
Owen: If terrarium, who packs plants for shipping? I can help wrap 6 boxes.
Nora: I can make a 30-sec video montage and a digital card link. Posting in #general during standup?
people-ops-bot: :memo: Reminder created: "Collect addresses + order terrariums" scheduled for 1965450000.
Samir: Final: terrarium 4-1. Terrarium it is. @Owen please DM for pickup/packing help.
Ivy: Optional micro-fund for nicer pots $3 suggested (Venmo @redwood-bday).
Halle: I'll do shipping labels and mark "no sesame" on bakery items if needed.
people-ops-bot: :tada: Thread closed  plan=terrarium, budget_est=$130, remotes=6, owners=[Owen,Halle,Nora].
